text: This oxygen tank nearly killed three astronauts, and it was damaged before it ever left the ground. Two years before launch, it was jolted. Then, in a ground test, its heater ran for hours on the wrong voltage. The safety switches welded shut, and the wiring inside was cooked. Fifty-six hours into Apollo thirteen, the tank's fans were switched on. The damaged wires sparked, in pure oxygen. The tank blew apart, and took a whole panel off the spacecraft. How they survived is incredible. Full video on my channel.
